attempts.why: Scope dropdown selectors to direct child > summary (+ ul) so nested details/summary inside the menu do not inherit dropdown trigger/menu styles and retain accordion appearance.

selfVerify.reason: Top dropdown trigger retains bordered field + down-chevron dropdown styling while nested 'Solid (accordion)' inside the open menu does not inherit it - it shows as a plain menu row with right-facing accordion disclosure '>' not a bordered field/chevron, confirming direct-child scoping prevents style bleed and preserves accordion appearance.

pick.suspected: Dropdown component uses over-broad details/summary/ul selectors without direct-child scoping so the nested accordion <details> inside the dropdown inherits the dropdown trigger/menu styling (bordered field + chevron) and no longer looks/behaves as an accordion.
